answer: A bond is refunded only after 42 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The vault counter is kept in beacon and voyage shows each reset. An attacker thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 42 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2529 identities would post 4295 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
